props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. Always pass it explicitly. outline is the preferred choice unless the design calls for another.

values.name: outline
values.whenToUse: The default choice when the design doesn't specify.

props.name: theme
props.description: Meaning of the status. Translate requests to these values: error or failed is danger, passed or healthy is success, idle or unknown is muted. There is no purple or error theme. info, merged and risk are for CI/CD and DevOps products.

values.name: muted
values.whenToUse: Neutral, inactive, unknown or not started.

values.name: info
values.whenToUse: An informational state in a CI/CD or DevOps product.
values.whenToNotUse: Outside CI/CD and DevOps. Use muted, success, warning or danger.

values.name: merged
values.whenToUse: A merged state, such as a merged pull request, in a CI/CD or DevOps product.

values.name: risk
values.whenToUse: A risk state in a CI/CD or DevOps product.
values.whenToNotUse: Outside CI/CD and DevOps. Use warning or danger.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Always pass text: colour and icon only reinforce it, and colour alone fails colourblind users.

props.name: icon
props.description: An IconV2 name shown beside the text. Not allowed with variant status.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Animates the indicator dot. Only allowed with variant status.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Don't override colour or size.
